# Templates — Reusable Document Templates

This directory contains reusable templates for documenting incidents, launches, and other project processes. Each template follows established industry practices.

## Available Templates

| Template | Purpose | When to Use |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| [**postmortem-template.md**](./postmortem-template.md) | Structured incident postmortem with severity, timeline, root cause analysis, action items, and follow-up tracking | After any production incident (P1/P2/P3) to document what happened, why, and how to prevent recurrence |
| [**pr-faq-template.md**](./pr-faq-template.md) | PR/FAQ (Press Release / Frequently Asked Questions) document for defining a feature or product launch from the customer's perspective | At the start of any new feature or initiative to align the team on customer problem, solution, and success criteria |

## References

- [Google SRE Workbook — Postmortem Culture](https://sre.google/workbook/postmortem-culture/) — Incident analysis methodology and best practices
- [Amazon Working Backwards](https://www.amazon.com/Working-Backwards-Insights-Stories-Secrets/dp/1250267595) — PR/FAQ technique for customer-centric product definition
